teaser: Your hand stops over a dropped screw, mid-reach, deciding whether to chase it or let it roll under the bench. That pause is close to the shape of being a life path 11 built on ISTP hands. Eleven asks for a kind of charged, inspired presence; ISTP asks for proof that can be held, a thing turned over in the fingers before it gets trusted. In you, the inspiration rarely arrives as a vision. It shows up as an instinct in the hands — the moment before the fix, when the room goes quiet and you already know where the fault is.
excerpt: Scissors click somewhere close to your ear, and the mirror gets more attention than the small talk, because small talk in a salon chair has never felt like the real exchange.
